🌟 UNITED WE TRIBE 🌟

🔥 CACAO · SINGING CIRCLE ·  ECSTATIC DANCE · LIVE MUSIC · OPEN CIRCLE 🔥

A full day immersion to open our hearts with cacao, singing, dancing, and sharing. We gather to celebrate the good, the bad, the beauty and the ugly — standing accountable to the life we are living. United as one tribe, one family, one love. We close the day by offering the circle to you: song, poetry, art, or whatever form your medicine takes.

🗓 PROGRAM

13:00 — Doors Open

14:00 — Cacao & Singing Circle

17:00 — Ecstatic Dance

19:30 — Food Nourishment

20:30 — Live Music

21:00 — Open Circle

23:00 — Closing

📅 Saturday, 27 June 2026

📍 Essência, Aljezur (Algarve)
